title: AAS77733 Reproducibility Package: A global test of an apparent mid-redshift residual feature in Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae
description: Frozen reproducibility package for the revised AAS77733 analysis. The package supports a non-detection / identifiability result for the historical z~0.4 Pantheon+ residual candidate and contains the publication battery, R1 hardening checks, immutable public-data provenance, dependency pins, numerical checkpoints, covariance-semantics traceability, and reviewer-response mapping.

creators.name: Pereira, Dener
